scope: Developer-authored fixed local semantics contract; not independent holdout

cases.rationale: An exhausted loop runs else; surviving normal completion has s=True.
No break exists; else returns before the later call.
Literal empty iterable has no body execution.
Empty literal executes else.
Normal loop completion overwrites s with False.

cases.source:
import trimesh
def f(a,b,flag,fn):
    flags=[False,False]
    flags[0]=True
    s,r=flags
    trimesh.registration.icp(a,b,scale=s,reflection=r)
cases.rationale: Mutable list cannot retain stale elements after assignment.

import trimesh

    alias=flags

cases.rationale: Mutation through alias invalidates element assumptions.
